rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: The Keeper of Secrets
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person entrusted with what others cannot know, letting selective disclosure determine what everyone is allowed to discuss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may read the first paragraph of the picnic briefing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not the second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're not cleared to ask about paragraph two yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That disclosure has moved us ahead of schedule.

card.title: The Keeper of Secrets
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person entrusted with what others cannot know, letting selective disclosure determine what everyone is allowed to discuss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bride left me these envelopes. You can announce the tables, but not who's sitting together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm seating the guests. They need names.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me one guest at a time. I'll release their chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I at least take couples together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me which couple. I'll disclose whether they're still being seated as one.

card.title: Authority by Bluff
card.instruction: Project control through confident half-answers while guarding the possibility that one direct question could expose how little you actually know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got tomorrow's inspection covered. Leave the folder with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does page four say we need two sinks?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It requires an appropriate number for the operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plumber's here. Shall I ask him to read it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have him quote for one and two. I'll confirm which interpretation we're implementing.

card.title: Authority by Bluff
card.instruction: Project control through confident half-answers while guarding the possibility that one direct question could expose how little you actually know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know why the shop alarm sounded. We can open on time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was it the back door or the motion sensor?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The system detected activity in the relevant area.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring up the log. You can show me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read me your interpretation first. I don't want my findings influencing yours.

card.title: Professional Suspicion
card.instruction: Treat inconsistencies, evasions, and missing details as evidence your trained eye should investigate before anyone proceeds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I approve your expenses: the receipt says four, your note says four-oh-five.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought a biscuit on the way back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then there's a second transaction missing from your account.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid for it myself. Here, have the other one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two biscuits. I'll need to revise the timeline before I sign.

card.title: Professional Suspicion
card.instruction: Treat inconsistencies, evasions, and missing details as evidence your trained eye should investigate before anyone proceeds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we hand over the shop keys, why did you cross out cupboard and write shelf?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remembered where I found them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What made you name the cupboard first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shelf is inside the cupboard. I'll show you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. I need to establish why your correction made the location look different.

card.title: Cleared to Know
card.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass me the unredacted reunion plan. I'm family, not the public.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That page lists everyone's surprise presents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Family should get more than the visitor edition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It includes your present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me who chose it. I should know who considers me family.

card.title: Cleared to Know
card.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why does my club briefing have blacked-out names?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only the organising committee sees those.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stacked every chair for that committee. Surely I've earned the names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can apply next month. I'll sponsor you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Could you put one name in my copy now, so I know you're sponsoring a member?

card.title: The Initiated One
card.instruction: Treat others as recent initiates, revealing rules and information in carefully measured doses that preserve your seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've earned the first half of the secret handshake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I learn the rest?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wanting it immediately suggests the first half hasn't settled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's just a handshake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's why you're still on fingers, not the wrist.

card.title: The Initiated One
card.instruction: Treat others as recent initiates, revealing rules and information in carefully measured doses that preserve your seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to the club. Tonight I'll teach you rule one: discretion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The secretary gave me the whole rulebook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Keep it closed while we establish discretion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to proofread it before printing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then read me each sentence. I'll tell you which ones you're ready to understand.

card.title: Information Is Leverage
card.instruction: Remain outwardly cooperative while controlling one useful fact, releasing only enough of it to shape each decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can help find your parcel. The van number starts with four; let's check my route first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are six vans starting with four.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only two end in seven. Mine passes both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, your route. Which van do we stop at?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Happy to guide you. Take my overdue collection first, then I'll point it out.

card.title: Information Is Leverage
card.instruction: Remain outwardly cooperative while controlling one useful fact, releasing only enough of it to shape each decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can trace your missing projector approval. It came from upstairs; shall we review my repair budget together?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was it the director or her deputy?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The signature starts with M. Let's put repairs on today's agenda.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're on. Purchasing still needs the surname.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Move repairs before refreshments and I'll give you the name for the purchase order.

card.title: Our First Secret
card.instruction: Treat a shared secret from the beginning of the relationship as the truest proof of what still connects you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit with me at the reunion. Purple gate: our first day, the headmaster's bicycle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thirty years ago. I'm the headmaster now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you still lowered your voice at purple gate. That's my old friend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have to sit at the staff table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save me the chair beside you. You trusted me with a headmaster's bicycle before you trusted any staff.

card.title: Our First Secret
card.instruction: Treat a shared secret from the beginning of the relationship as the truest proof of what still connects you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we pack Mum's biscuit tin, knock twice. That was our first secret.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She knew we emptied it. She told me years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still kept our signal. There's my brother.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You take the tin. We hardly see each other now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then knock twice when you visit. I'll know you're here for our tin, even if it's full.

card.title: I Covered for You
card.instruction: Carry past concealment as an unpaid favor, expecting trust, access, and protection whenever the old debt becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told Dad you were with me when you dented his car. Tell him I didn't break his greenhouse.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was ten years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ten years I've kept your evening accounted for. I need one afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't lie. I'll come with you while you tell him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit beside me. If he calls me careless, remind him how reliable I've been for you.

card.title: I Covered for You
card.instruction: Carry past concealment as an unpaid favor, expecting trust, access, and protection whenever the old debt becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Show me next month's private rota. I told the manager you were making deliveries when you missed that shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thanked you. I can't give you the manager's password.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You trusted me with a whole missing afternoon. I only want to see Saturdays.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll check your Saturdays myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And put us together. If anyone questions it, say I'm someone you can rely on.

card.title: The Cleanup Person
card.instruction: Return to the familiar role of containing damage, correcting stories, and protecting everyone from the consequences of disclosure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you explain the broken window to Mum, give me your versions. Like last time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said football. Jamie said the wind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we start with the broken window and our offer to pay. Leave weather out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Jamie already texted her about a storm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the repair quote. I'll send something useful before she asks which storm plays football.

card.title: The Cleanup Person
card.instruction: Return to the familiar role of containing damage, correcting stories, and protecting everyone from the consequences of disclosure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've peeled the surprise-party labels off the boxes by her desk. Same rescue service as last year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you. I told her they're printer supplies.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll move the balloons before she asks which printer takes helium.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She offered to unpack them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her I'll handle it. She already thinks I do all the office jobs; we can keep the cake under that.

card.title: First to Solve It
card.instruction: Treat each clue and inconsistency as a contest over who can understand the situation first and most completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Found your missing parcel: the tracking sheet says bay six, but that's a nine upside down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good catch. I'll check bay nine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Check van nine too. I've already worked out why the bay number won't be enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in van nine. How did you know?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The departure time. Now read me the address; I want the whole route solved before you start the engine.

card.title: First to Solve It
card.instruction: Treat each clue and inconsistency as a contest over who can understand the situation first and most completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our mystery judge is the baker. Flour on the invitation. Solved before you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The miller uses flour too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it's the miller. I've already moved past the obvious answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's icing on the envelope flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The baker, licking it after decorating. I've got the identity and the sequence; you've got ingredients.

transfer.action: I show only one section of {prop}, covering the rest.
transfer.opening: That's the part you're cleared to discuss. {request}
transfer.response: The next detail goes through me. {counter}
transfer.closing: Because knowing has stages, and I'm holding the timetable.

transfer.action: I confidently tap the closed notes beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: The details are entirely under control. {request}
transfer.response: We don't need to open everything to proceed. {counter}
transfer.closing: I prefer not to interrupt the summary with questions about its preparation.

transfer.action: I compare two times beside {prop} and circle the difference.
transfer.response: The crossed-out word had a reason to exist. {counter}
transfer.challenge: It was only a small mistake.
transfer.closing: Excellent. A small mistake should be easy to account for precisely.

transfer.action: I turn my visitor badge facedown and pull {prop} closer.
transfer.opening: If I'm one of us, I can ask this. {request}
transfer.response: Don't give me the public version now. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then we've reached the exact part that tells me whether I belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm family. Why am I getting the public version of what happened to the wedding cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone dropped it off the balcony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Does the family version include a name?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me where you were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You want my alibi before giving me family gossip? That's the police version.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Uses the family/public-summary distinction from S124-single-a and the cake/balcony probe from D06-single-a. A wedding replaces the separate reunion and party as one shared setting. Unlike the original, B supplies the balcony and A withholds an alibi.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why is my report on the missing keys censored? I'm on this committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's for the inner committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can an outer member at least know where they were found?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The location starts with 'under'. That's all you get.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What would I have to chair to earn the next word?

bespokePairs.seedUse: Retains the committee report and exclusion from S124-single-b and the missing-key inquiry from D06-single-b. A no longer leaks the drain. A proposed chair role converts belonging into a route to increasingly specific information.

card.title: Cleared to Know
card.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass me the unredacted reunion plan. I'm family, not the public.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That page lists everyone's surprise presents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Family should get more than the visitor edition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It includes your present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me who chose it. I should know who considers me family.

card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you say you heard about the party, which part?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bit with the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before or after it reached the balcony?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened on the balcony?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing confirmed. Who's been using that word?

card.title: Cleared to Know
card.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why does my club briefing have blacked-out names?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only the organising committee sees those.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stacked every chair. Apparently my arms joined before the rest of me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can apply next month.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I see the unredacted application, or is that intimate too?

card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That they're missing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No mention of a drain, then?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should there be?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking how thorough the briefing was.

transfer.action: I expose one small part of {prop}, keeping the rest covered.
transfer.response: Repeat the first rule before asking for the second. {counter}
transfer.closing: Because knowing the ending is what makes someone no longer a beginner.

transfer.action: I keep the last useful note about {prop} folded in my palm.
transfer.opening: One useful fact at a time. {request}
transfer.response: We can arrange when the next detail arrives. {counter}
transfer.closing: Make the next step worth unfolding it for.

transfer.action: I put {prop} beside our old secret hiding box.
transfer.opening: The false bottom still knows both our names. {request}
transfer.response: Use the old signal; this part belongs to us. {counter}
transfer.closing: And neither of us has needed to explain the signal yet.

transfer.action: I place my old account that protected you beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I was your alibi before I was your inconvenience. {request}
transfer.response: That silence took effort worth remembering. {counter}
transfer.challenge: I don't owe you a story.
transfer.closing: Then perhaps my old story has been carrying more of us than I thought.

transfer.action: I collect every contradictory note around {prop}.
transfer.opening: I'll tidy the versions before they acquire witnesses. {request}
transfer.response: Give me the messy part while it's still small. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then let me remove the labels that explain you badly before you begin.

transfer.action: I put my initials beside the new clue on {prop}.
transfer.opening: Found it first. Write that down. {request}
transfer.response: You can catch up after I've tested the answer. {counter}
transfer.closing: My pencil was already numbering the together part.
